title: Personal Loans AutoPay Enrollment Rate After a Term Extension Modification or a Recent AutoPay Return
content:
## Rule

For a Personal Loans AutoPay enrollment whose rate is worked out from the base interest rate, the enrollment rate form follows the loan's record and acts on the standard rate, the loan's base interest rate less the AutoPay discount of the enrollment:

- when the loan's Term Extension Modification was completed, the modification's rate reduction, its pre-plan interest rate less its plan interest rate, comes off the standard rate, never taking the rate below that program's modified-rate floor;
- otherwise, when an AutoPay debit on the loan was returned fewer than 3 whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the enrollment date, 0.25 point is added back to the standard rate, never taking it above the loan's base interest rate;
- in every other case the record does not change the rate.

The modification, its pre-plan and plan interest rates and its program's modified-rate floor are those of the loan's completed Term Extension Modification under the Hardship Assistance Programs. An AutoPay debit returned is a return of a payment AutoPay took on the loan. The rate is rounded to two decimals once, at the end.

| Loan's record | Rate in force |
|---|---|
| completed Term Extension Modification | standard rate less (pre-plan rate less plan rate), not below the program's floor |
| no completed modification; AutoPay debit returned fewer than 3 whole months before | standard rate plus 0.25, not above the base interest rate |
| neither | not changed by the record |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Base rate 19.00, standard rate 18.50; completed modification with pre-plan rate 19.00 and plan rate 16.00: 18.50 less 3.00 is 15.50, which stands if it is not below the program's floor.
- Base rate 16.00, standard rate 15.75; an AutoPay debit returned 2 whole months before: 15.75 plus 0.25 is 16.00, not above the base rate.
- Base rate 16.00, standard rate 15.90; the same return: 16.15 would exceed the base rate, so 16.00.
- An AutoPay return 3 whole months before the enrollment date: not fewer than 3, so not changed.
